verdict.rationale: The Known Faces report compares an applicant's latest captured likeness against media from previous applicants in the account database. It flags faces that have already been through the verification flow, which directly covers repeat-face identity fraud. Missing for 10: evidence of duplicate-document detection (the same document reused under different names), explicit handling of name or identity mismatches on a matched face, details on automatic flagging or result breakdowns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
